ryan_sales: Quick heads-up: NimbusHealth is asking for a 12mo commit. Estimate ~18M tokens/mo, peak ~1k concurrent short chat sessions, 95th <=280ms, HIPAA + BAA required. They want reserved GPUs, burst credits, autoscale, and cross-region fallback for DR. Can infra/sec/pricing advise? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1999 :wave:

ada_platform: Clarifying q's: concurrent = in-flight requests? avg prompt+resp tokens? streaming sessions or purely request/response? any embeddings mix?

ryan_sales: Yes in-flight. avg combined ~380 tokens. ~10% sessions use streaming updates, embeddings ~8% (nightly batch). Theywill accept 4-bit quantized open models (neoX-style) and asked about multi-model routing (accuracy vs latency).

morgan_sre: Throughput assumptions: A100-equivalent ~=125 RPS @~380 tokens (quantized conservative). Baseline GPUs = ceil(1000/125) = 8. Add 50% headroom for 15-30min flash windows -> +4. Streaming sessions need sticky capacity; add 1 reserved for sticky session affinity. Proposed baseline = 9 reserved + 4 burst = autoscale up to 13. Recommend AZ spread (2 AZs) and cross-region DR pool (cold standby) if they want RTO <30m. Spot allowed for burst only, cap 25%.

ada_platform: Proposed autoscale policy (for Dedicated config) to paste into editor:
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 9,
  "max_replicas": 13,
  "scale_metric": "tokens_per_second",
  "target_tokens_per_second_per_replica": 48000,
  "scale_up_cooldown_secs": 30,
  "scale_down_cooldown_secs": 300,
  "burst_policy": {
    "burst_pool_credits": 4,
    "max_burst_duration_minutes": 40
  },
  "sticky_streaming_reservation": 1
}
```

pricing_bot: Need a ballpark for SOW (reserved 12mo vs on-demand) and DR add-on license note.

morgan_sre: Back-of-envelope pricing: reserved A100-equiv $7,100/GPU-mo -> 9 * $7,100 = $63,900 baseline. Burst credits priced at ~35% of reserved rate when consumed. If bursts used ~12% of month: 4 * $7,100 * 0.35 * 0.12 ~= $1,198. Add compliance & 24/7 enterprise support surcharge ~16% => rough monthly ~($63,900 + $1,200) * 1.16 ~= $75k. Add cross-region DR standby line item if they require <30m RTO (est +20% infra). Finance to finalize.

olivia_security: HIPAA checklist: BAA required; customer-managed KMS (CMK) for envelope keys; TLS1.2+ and mTLS for private endpoints; VPC peering/private endpoints; SIEM forwarding to customer's Splunk (via Kinesis or TLS syslog); audit logs export to customer S3 (365d); yearly pen-test attestation. Private deployment recommended to satisfy BAA+CMK. Legal sign-off needed for BAA.

morgan_sre: Operational notes to meet tail SLOs:
- KV/prefix cache TTL = 4h for interactive sessions; streaming sessions have separate sticky cache semantics.
- Preheat: traffic-replay at ~15% of expected peak 45 minutes before the flash window; full KV prefill 10-15m before peak.
- Canary: 5-10% traffic for 10 minutes after any model roll or config change.
- Tail mitigation: if 95th > 400ms for 3m or 99th > 1s for 2m, trigger circuit-breaker to route new sessions to low-latency variant and auto-scale up; notify SRE channel and open OP ticket.

preheat_bot: [preheat-bot] created OP-9991: preheat + warmup runbook for NimbusHealth (assigned to @morgan_sre).

morgan_sre: Ops smoke snippet for runbook (drop into OP-9991):
```bash
# nimbus-smoke.sh - kv warm + streaming probe
python infra/tools/replay.py --model nimbus-prod --rps 100 --duration 900 --streaming-probe 20
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"nimbus-prod","kv_preheat":true,"streaming_probe":true}'
```

ryan_sales: Action items: I'll draft SOW with 9x reserved + 4x burst credits and include cross-region DR option and cost ballpark. Olivia will run security answers and ping Legal for BAA. Pricing_bot to prepare formal quote and DR license line. Morgan to attach OP-9991 runbook. I'll schedule a tech handoff with NimbusHealth Wed 9:30am PT. Thanks everyone :handshake:
